capabilities.label: Writing
capabilities.description: Choose one writing and planning engine: Ollama, OpenAI, Google Gemini, MiniMax Text, or Off.

capabilities.label: Images
capabilities.description: Choose ComfyUI, Ollama-assisted ComfyUI, OpenAI, MiniMax, or Manual Import.

capabilities.label: Video
capabilities.description: Choose a local hardware-compatible video plug-in, OpenAI Video, MiniMax H3 cloud, or Off.

principles: A route is active per capability, not through one global local/cloud switch.
Local and cloud routes can be mixed and reported as hybrid.
Installed or configured is not the same as ready.
No paid or cloud provider is selected automatically.
Local installation detection uses reviewed local probes only.
Local capabilities select plug-ins by hardware fit; runtimes such as ComfyUI and Ollama remain implementation dependencies rather than user-facing capability names.

plugins.label: SDXL 1.0
plugins.description: PlotPickle's managed local image plug-in using the fixed SDXL 1.0 workflow.

plugins.label: LTX-Video 2B 0.9.8 Distilled
plugins.description: Lightweight local text-to-video plug-in using the existing reviewed ComfyUI LTX adapter.

plugins.label: MiniMax H3
plugins.description: Advanced local MiniMax H3 plug-in through a reviewed native ComfyUI workflow.

routes.label: Off
routes.description: Keep writing assistance off. PlotPickle remains fully usable.

routes.label: Ollama · Local
routes.description: Use the selected Ollama LLM installed on this computer.

routes.label: OpenAI · Cloud
routes.description: Use the selected OpenAI text model through the user-owned API account.

routes.label: Google Gemini · Provider Cloud
routes.description: Use the configured Gemini writing model through Google's OpenAI-compatible API contract and the user-owned API key.

routes.label: MiniMax Text · Cloud
routes.description: Use the MiniMax text model configured with the same account that can provide H3 video.

routes.label: Manual Import
routes.description: Create images elsewhere and import them without an AI request.

routes.label: ComfyUI · Local
routes.description: Generate images through the selected local checkpoint and reviewed workflow.

routes.label: Ollama + ComfyUI · Local
routes.description: Use the selected Ollama LLM to refine the visual prompt, then generate locally through ComfyUI.

routes.label: OpenAI Images · Cloud
routes.description: Generate or edit images through the configured OpenAI image model.

routes.label: MiniMax Images · Cloud
routes.description: Use the configured MiniMax image model through the user-owned account.

routes.label: Off
routes.description: Do not generate video. Existing and imported video assets remain available.

routes.label: Local Video · Compatibility Route
routes.description: Legacy compatibility route while local video model/workflow choice moves to the hardware-aware plug-in registry.

routes.label: OpenAI Video · Cloud
routes.description: Create an asynchronous OpenAI video job through the configured account.

routes.label: MiniMax H3 · Cloud
routes.description: Send one approved video request to the configured MiniMax account.

extensionPoints.pluginAdapters: existing reviewed local gateway identified by plugins[].adapterId
